text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon takes 1st—!! Just as 
promised, she conquers the Yasuda Kinen 
with style!!
(Waaaaaaahhh--!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was amazing! Hishi Amazon! I 
wonder what race she'll run next?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she'd run in the Japan Cup or 
the Arima Kinen, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Once Narita Brian comes back, I'm sure 
we'll get to see an amazing race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Did you see that, Trainy?! I 
totally dominated that one-on-one!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. 1st place in both, just like I 
promised. That oughta add a little shine 
to my reputation, wouldn't ya say?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And so... All that's left is a one-on-one 
showdown at the Arima Kinen, huh.

—And Hishi Amazon showed a gesture as if 
deep in thought.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainy. Mind if I stand on a big 
stage one more time before the Arima 
Kinen?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, at first, both the Osaka Hai 
and the Yasuda Kinen were just for the 
sake of this year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"That race was so you could get stronger 
before then. Right?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still... how do I put it! Once I got out 
there, it was super fun!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I was surrounded by absolute beasts! 
Sparks and lightning flyin' everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If I can hold my own in a proper 
one-on-one fight in a crazy place like 
that, I feel like I can grow one step 
further—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I guess I don't need any excuses. 
I just want to run in the Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And that's where I wanna have another 
insane showdown!

Thinking of the fierce battles awaiting 
her in the future, Hishi Amazon spoke with 
excitement in her voice.

There is absolutely no reason to stop 
them.

Our next target is decided: the Japan Cup, 
where the fiercest competitors gather!
